messages:
maya: Quick thread 1: we need a short, repeatable DP playbook for recruitment -> pilot -> postmortem. Goal: 8 partners, 2x 2-week pilots, clear pass/fail and incentive terms.

fiona: Love it. Can we bake in a lightweight non-disclosure + data handling checklist up front? Some partners will want logs kept for 90d, others not.

desh: Agree on checklist. Also recommend a small stipend ($2k) or account credits for partners who supply prompt sets and join weekly evals. Helps commitment.

linh: For scope capture: propose 3 buckets in scoping workshop: Must (blockers for pilot), Should (high value), Nice (future). 200m max. I'll publish a one-pager.

ravi: Security note: any partner asking for KMS/HSM or private deployment needs the SOW addendum. That triggers infra lead time (~10 business days). Flag early.

maya: Draft pilot pass/fail rubric (proposed):
```
- Integration: sample app + SDK call in partner env (yes/no)
- Flow validation: 2/2 target flows exercised end-to-end
- Quality: no >5% negative delta on partner-critical prompts
- Latency: median p50 < 300ms for profiled requests
- Ops: partner responded to weekly triage and filed feedback tickets
Pass = all Integration + Flow AND (Quality OR Latency) met
```
Thoughts?

desh: Suggest we require a paired demo at pilot end where partner shows flows and we run a live regression checklist. That saves post-hoc surprises.

fiona: On recruiting copy: short DM + optional deeper info packet. DM = 2 sentences. Packet = scoping template + SOW summary + timeline.

linh: I'll create a recruit spreadsheet with columns: partner, contact, overlap_check (private_beta?), stipend, commitment_hours, critical_prompts, model_variant, status.

maya: Owners: fiona -> outreach + incentive terms, linh -> scoping + spreadsheet, desh -> pilot eval checklist + demo script, ravi -> legal + SOW. Milestone: outreach drafts + SOW sketch by Mon EOD, first scoping sessions next Wed.

ops-bot: Calendar: provisional event "DP Scoping Sprint" created for next Wed 09:30-12:00. Invites sent to owners.

ravi: I'll draft the SOW addendum and include an optional HSM clause. Also looping security for any shipping of logs.

maya: Good. Also we need a tiny rubric to prioritize partner feature asks during pilot: 1) customer pain (high/med/low), 2) rollout difficulty (1-5), 3) value delta (est. tokens saved / latency improved). We'll keep it simple.

desh: Can we add a short postmortem template? Key sections: what we tested, pass/fail, partner feedback (top 3), follow-ups (owner + ETA),商业 value estimate.

fiona: I'll draft the outreach DM and packet and post here for signoff.

maya: Final ask: keep the pilot lightweight and instrumented. We want clear metrics not anecdotes. Add a shared Grafana link for each partner.

ops-bot: Note: created docket 'DP-Pilot-Runbook' in Docs and added owners as editors.
